verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack describes a DNS-records CRUD API. The cited Registrar API covers searching, registering and managing domains, not record-level operations. Indirect support exists: Registrar domains must use Cloudflare nameservers, a community user describes third parties modifying DNS via a Cloudflare API key (though one with full-account scope), and a Cloudflare comment says DNS changes propagate in about 15 seconds. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of DNS record create/update/delete endpoints, scoped API tokens limited to DNS edits, evidence of ACME DNS-01 challenge automation, independent hands-on corroboration.
